title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional student-focused spaces at D'Youville University, from specialized labs and wellness retreats to quiet study nooks and affordable campus entertainment.

cards.title: Collaborative Innovation at The Hive
cards.subtitle: Health Professions Hub
cards.notes: Visit this collaborative workspace in the Health Professions Hub designed for students and faculty to ideate and work on interdisciplinary projects together.
cards.short_summary: A modern collaborative workspace located within the Health Professions Hub for innovation and group projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hive is described as a collaborative workspace that brings students, faculty, staff, and community members together to ideate and collaborate.
cards.access_notes: Open to students and faculty; located within the Health Professions Hub building.

cards.title: Quiet Reset at the Wellness Lodge
cards.subtitle: Koessler Administration Building, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Head to the third floor of KAB for a dedicated relaxation space offering yoga, meditation, and chair massages to help manage academic stress.
cards.short_summary: A student wellness retreat in the Koessler Administration Building providing meditation and relaxation services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellness Lodge on the 3rd floor of KAB offers events including yoga, meditation, art, and chair massages for students to relax and reset.
cards.access_notes: Located on the 3rd floor of KAB; check university schedule for specific wellness event times.

cards.title: Lower Level Social Hub at Maggie's
cards.subtitle: Dr. Pauline M. Alt Building
cards.notes: Grab a smoothie or snack at this lower-level cafe, which features plenty of tables and outdoor dining for socializing between lab sessions.
cards.short_summary: A casual dining and social spot located in the lower level of the Dr. Pauline M. Alt Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Maggie's Café is located in the lower level of the ALT building and offers sandwiches, smoothies, and outdoor dining space.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the elevator in the ALT building; offers both indoor and outdoor seating.

cards.title: Affordable Arts at the Kavinoky
cards.subtitle: Koessler Administration Building
cards.notes: Take advantage of $5 student tickets to see professional live theatre performances in this historic venue located right on campus.
cards.short_summary: A professional theatre venue on campus offering heavily discounted tickets for D'Youville students.
cards.evidence_claim: D'Youville University students can purchase single tickets for $5 at the Kavinoky Theatre box office with a valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Box office purchase required for student discount; must provide D'Youville ID.

cards.title: Split-Level Workouts at the DAC
cards.subtitle: D'Youville Academic Center
cards.notes: Utilize the split-level gym with weights in the basement and cardio equipment on the 6th floor, featuring modern machines and locker rooms.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary fitness facility, distributed across the basement and 6th floor of the Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center in the DAC has free weights and machines in the basement and cardio equipment on the 6th floor.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 6 AM - 10 PM and weekends 9 AM - 7 PM for the campus community.

cards.title: Focused Study in Montante Library
cards.subtitle: Montante Family Library
cards.notes: Reserve a private study room or group pod online to secure a quiet space with whiteboards and HDMI connectivity for exam prep.
cards.short_summary: Reservable private and group study spaces within the university's main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can reserve study spaces like quiet carrels, group rooms, or study pods through the library's online booking tool.
cards.access_notes: Online reservation recommended; student credentials required for booking.

cards.title: Quiet Reflection in SASE 312
cards.subtitle: School of Arts, Sciences and Education, Room 312
cards.notes: Find a moment of peace in this dedicated interfaith space located on the third floor of the SASE building, open to all traditions.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated room for prayer and meditation for students of all faith backgrounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The All Faiths Prayer Room is located in SASE 312 as part of the university's campus ministry resources.
cards.access_notes: Located in Room 312 of the SASE building; open during building hours.

cards.title: On-Demand Support at the Tech Lounge
cards.subtitle: Bauer Family Academic Center, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Stop by the first floor of BFAC for immediate technology assistance and a space to work where support professionals are readily available.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused student lounge providing IT support and workspace in the Bauer Family Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tech Lounge, located on the first floor of the Bauer Family Academic Center, is staffed with professionals to assist with classroom technology.
cards.access_notes: Located on the 1st floor of BFAC; walk-in support available.

cards.title: Culinary Learning at D'Lish
cards.subtitle: Health Professions Hub
cards.notes: Participate in free cooking classes and learn about medically tailored meals in this state-of-the-art demonstration kitchen.
cards.short_summary: A demonstration kitchen in the Health Professions Hub offering nutrition education and cooking classes.
cards.evidence_claim: D'Lish Demonstration Kitchen offers free cooking classes and is run by the D'Youville Department of Nutrition and Dietetics.
cards.access_notes: Located within the Hub; check the D'Lish schedule for class times.

cards.title: Recreational Breaks in the CC
cards.subtitle: College Center
cards.notes: Unwind between classes in the College Center's game room, which offers recreational equipment and a social atmosphere for students.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated recreational space for students located within the College Center building.
cards.evidence_claim: The College Center holds a swimming pool, gym, fitness center, and a game room, all fully equipped and free to students.
cards.access_notes: Located in the College Center; free access for students with ID.
